title: Jensen Huang Said to Have Had Relationship With Nvidia Executive Who Reports to Him
partialText: Mr. Huang, Nvidia’s chief executive, is already facing scrutiny over an affair with a Chinese businesswoman who U.S. intelligence determined was a Chinese spy.

title: Nvidia Scandal Unveils a Fierce Spy War Raging Behind Trump and Xi’s Diplomacy
partialText: That the United States suspected Nvidia’s leader was a Chinese spy target underscores the deep distrust between the two powers, even as their leaders try to stabilize ties.

title: Nvidia Scandal Puts Lori Huang, Jensen Huang’s Wife, In the Spotlight
partialText: Lori Huang, who has been married to the Nvidia chief executive for more than 40 years, stands out among tech titan spouses for how private she has been.

title: Who Is Alice Huang, the Woman in the Middle of Nvidia’s Spy Scandal?
partialText: Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence determined is a Chinese asset, emerged from the high-flying world of Shanghai finance to work with tech titans and obtain essential A.I. chips.

title: Trump Hints at Immigration Deal, Then Reverses. He’s Done That Before.
partialText: Democrats and some Republicans say President Trump is missing an opportunity to find consensus on an issue that has bedeviled past administrations.

title: ICE Officer Involved in Maine Shooting Expressed Hatred of Immigrants
partialText: The agent talked of foreign bloodlines, denounced noncitizens and more, according to emails obtained by The Times. His fatal shooting of a Colombian-born motorist in July remains under investigation.

title: An 8-Year-Old Was Separated From Family and Taken by ICE at a Check-In
partialText: The third grader from Haiti had been living with his uncle’s family since his father was deported last year. From a shelter where ICE sent him, “he cried and just begged to come home.”

title: White House Threatens Congress, Saying Aggressive Investigations Could Be Crime
partialText: As Democrats prepared to begin oversight inquiries, it was not clear what legal basis could support the threat. The Constitution grants lawmakers immunity for legislative acts.

title: Republicans Begin Aggressive Lame-Duck Push to Install Trump Judges
partialText: The G.O.P. intends to win confirmation of about two dozen federal judges before the party loses power. But Democrats promise to do what they can to stop them.

title: After Hegseth Impeachment Vote Fails, Massie Vows More Tough Votes for GOP In His Final Days
partialText: Representative Thomas Massie, the Kentucky Republican, said he would use his waning time in office to prod his party to vote for “sanity” and break with President Trump.

title: The S.S. United States, a Historic Supership, Heads to the Ocean Floor
partialText: The 20th-century ocean liner will become an artificial reef, ending efforts to save a ship that was fast, luxurious and (almost) indestructible.  Watch the livestream.

title: Recalling the S.S. United States as It Becomes a Florida Reef
partialText: A New York Times editor has had a lifelong connection to the S.S. United States, which is becoming an artificial reef off the Florida coast.

title: I Visited Big Bear Lake’s Famous Bald Eagles and Found Very Human Shenanigans
partialText: My I.R.L. adventures in the strange human world behind the enormously popular livestreaming eagle cam.

title: Trump Visits Arlington Cemetery as His Proposed Arch Faces Growing Opposition
partialText: An expanding legal fight over the proposed site of President Trump’s 250-foot triumphal arch looms over his visit to Arlington National Cemetery on Veterans Day.

title: How Democrats Invested Online to Overcome Their Cash Disadvantage
partialText: Strategists for Senate Democrats say they spent record sums reaching voters, particularly younger ones, on nontraditional platforms such as YouTube and various streaming sites.

title: Blue Texas? Battleground Kansas? Both Parties Wonder if the Map Has Shifted.
partialText: The breadth of Democrats’ midterm victories has raised new questions about which states will be competitive going forward — particularly Texas, a crown jewel in the Electoral College.

title: Raman and the D.S.A.: Wariness, Skepticism and Hope
partialText: Democratic socialists had another success with Ms. Raman’s ascent to the Los Angeles mayoralty. But she is no sure bet to align with all of the group’s priorities.

title: U.S. Efforts to Tighten Blockade of Iran Rely on Reluctant Neighbors
partialText: Washington wants to intensify its economic pressure campaign on Iran by closing its land borders. Neighboring states, fearing economic fallout, are pushing back.

title: Subtle Changes in Speech May Help Predict Dementia Risk
partialText: Signals can be detected in the way people talk years before symptoms of cognitive decline emerge, researchers are finding.

title: The View From Space the U.S. Government Doesn’t Want You to See
partialText: There are images from space that the U.S. government doesn’t want the public to see. Here’s why.

title: The Political Center of Gravity Isn’t Trump. It’s Obama.
partialText: America just isn’t a center-right country.

title: Alexander Darchiev, Russia’s Ambassador to the U.S., Dies at 66
partialText: The death of Alexander Darchiev was announced by Russia’s foreign ministry. He was appointed to his post in Washington in 2025, as relations between the Kremlin and the White House warmed.
